summary: Session-option snapshot, restore and apply helpers used when adopting an existing connection. snapshot_options reads each declared SessionOption (warning when one cannot be read), restore_options replays captured values, and apply_options applies caller-declared end-state values, warning once for undeclared names.
extension_points: Session options are declared per dialect in DialectSpec.adoption_mutations
documentation_hooks: Which DuckDB session options Ibis mutates on adoption (python_enable_replacements, TimeZone)
risks: Only DuckDB/MotherDuck declare adoption_mutations; other dialects adopt with no session preservation

evidence.detail: from_raw_connection and from_ibis_connection call these helpers
